gameName: Detective: A Modern Crime Board Game

steps.text: Board in reach; Investigation Team marker on Headquarters
Time marker on 8:00 AM, Day marker on day 1
Each player picks an investigator tile, faceup, and takes the Skill token shown bottom right
Unused tiles go Consultant side up; take their Skill tokens too
All those Skill tokens form the shared Token pool
Log in at antaresdatabase.com and choose the campaign and case
Case deck beside the board; read the casebook introduction, special rules and setup changes
Room for notes or a mind map, and a browser in reach

details: Reports: Write a report gives 2 Authority instead of 1
Second look: pay 1 Authority and the Skill token to Dig Deeper on an already resolved lead
Analysis: pay 2 Skill tokens to gain 1 Authority
Sources: pay 1 Skill token to turn another Skill token in the pool into 1 Authority
Support: pay 1 Authority to remove another investigator's Used Ability token

steps.text: Each ability once per day: mark it with a Used Ability token; clear them at day's end
Leads in another Location: move the IT marker there and advance Time 1 hour
Each hour after 4:00 PM adds 1 Stress; reaching the case's Stress limit ends the investigation
A drawn lead must be resolved; no peeking at its cost first
Plot cards go unread into the bag of the case they name
Pick a lead from the casebook's Further Leads and start the day at Headquarters
